entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A general approach for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using graphs, applied in legal, intelligence, patent, and software domains.

entities.name: Legal
entities.description: The field of application involving case analysis and legal consultation.

entities.name: Case Analysis
entities.description: A specific task in the legal domain addressed by GraphRAG.

entities.name: Legal Consultation
entities.description: A specific task in the legal domain addressed by GraphRAG.

entities.name: Intelligence Report Generation
entities.description: A real-world scenario where GraphRAG is applied to generate reports from event data.

entities.name: Patent Phrase Similarity Detection
entities.description: A real-world scenario where GraphRAG is applied to judge similarity between patent phrases.

entities.name: Software Understanding
entities.description: A real-world scenario where GraphRAG is applied to understand software dependencies.

entities.name: Ranade and Joshi
entities.description: Researchers who proposed a method for intelligence report generation using an Event Plot Graph.

entities.name: Event Plot Graph
entities.description: A graph structure constructed to retrieve critical aspects of events for intelligence report generation.

entities.name: Peng and Yang
entities.description: Researchers who proposed a method for patent phrase similarity detection using a patent-phrase graph.

entities.name: Patent-Phrase Graph
entities.description: A graph structure created to retrieve the ego network of patent phrases for similarity judgment.

entities.name: Alhanahnah et al.
entities.description: Researchers who proposed a Chatbot for software understanding using a dependency graph.

entities.name: Chatbot
entities.description: A system proposed to understand properties about dependencies in a given software package.

entities.name: Dependency Graph
entities.description: A graph automatically constructed to represent dependencies in a software package.
